errors.where: underside of canopy where pole meets it
errors.what: No ribs, stretchers or central hub under the canopy; the pole just disappears into the fabric, so nothing holds the canopy open

cards.fix: Show thin metal ribs radiating from a central hub at the top of the pole to each canopy point, with short stretchers connecting the ribs to a runner on the pole.

errors.where: long diagonal pole rising from the deck to the upper right, holding the rope from the mainmast
errors.what: Extra spar that sticks up from mid-deck at a steep angle. It has no sail and no real ship function; it looks like a stray pole only there to anchor the rope

errors.where: wooden ladders leaning against the masts
errors.what: Free-standing ladders lean on the masts and end at the sails. A real ship uses rope ratlines fixed to the hull sides, and these ladders lead nowhere

cards.fix: Remove the extra diagonal pole on deck and keep only a bowsprit at the bow; run the rigging rope from the masthead to the bowsprit tip; replace the leaning ladders with rope ratline shrouds attached to the hull sides and running up to the mast tops.

errors.what: The hour and minute hands are the same length and shape, so you cannot tell which is which

cards.fix: Make the minute hand clearly longer and thinner, reaching the minute track, and keep the hour hand short and wide.
